title: Viajes y culturas
who: un chico de 13 (B1), frases largas, se frustra si no le sale

transcripts.text: Hey there! I am Leo. I am really stoked to talk about travel and different cultures with you today. If you could pack your bags and go anywhere in the world right now, where would you choose to go?
I would choose go to Japan, because I love sushi and anime and I want to see the temples and try to speak some Japanese, even if I think it’s super hard and I might get lost in the big city.

That sounds like an amazing plan! You would choose to go to Japan because you love the culture and want to explore. I think that traveling there would be such an incredible adventure! Since you mentioned it might be hard, what do you think would be the most exciting part of being in Tokyo?

I think the most excitng part would be seeing all the bright neon lights at Shibuya crossing and maybe trying a crazy sushi bar where the chef throws the fish in the air, but I also worry that I’ll never understand the train map and I’ll get lost, which makes me kinda frustrated.

That sounds like a blast, especially the sushi bar! You said you worry that you'll never understand the map, but it's natural to feel a bit frustrated at first when everything is new. Do you think you would find it easier to navigate if you learned a few basic phrases before you go?

I think if I learn a few basic phrases like “arigato”, “gomen nasai” and “doko desu ka” it might be easier to ask for directions, but I’m scared I will forget them right when the train announcment is super fast and I have to speak fast, which makes me feel really annoyed and frustrated. It's totally normal to feel a bit annoyed when things move fast, but you're already learning great phrases! Even though it feels tough, do you think practicing with a friend could help you feel more confident?

Hey, I am Leo! It is great to meet you. Today, we are going to explore the world, talk about amazing cultures, and plan our dream trips. If you could travel anywhere in the world right now, where would you go?

I would love to go to Japan right now, because I love sushi, anime and the old temples, but I don't know how to talk about the culture very good and it makes me a bit angry when I cant find the right words.

That is a great choice! Japan sounds amazing. Don't worry about the language, you are doing great, and we can practice those words together. Since you are interested in the temples and anime, what do you think makes Japanese culture so special compared to others?
(sin respuesta)
Japan is a super cool place! Maybe think about the mix of old and new things there. Do you think that blend of ancient temples and modern anime is what makes it so unique?

I think the old temples with the bright neon lights and the crazy anime characters together make Japan feel like a place where you can walk in history and then see robots in the same street, but sometimes I get lost trying to say how the tradition and the technology are mixing, and it makes me a lit

It sounds like you are saying that the blend of tradition and technology makes Japan feel like a place where history and the future coexist. That is a perfect way to put it! When you see those contrasts, do you think it is more impressive than other places you have visited?
Hey there! I'm Leo. Today we are going to explore amazing countries and different cultures around the world. If you could travel anywhere right now, which country would you choose?
I would choose Japan, because I love the sushi and anime and I want to see the old temples and also the big city Tokyo, even if my parents say it is too far for me.

Japan sounds like an incredible choice! You want to see the temples and Tokyo because you love sushi and anime. That's awesome. Since you're interested in the culture, what is one specific thing you would want to do first once you arrive there?

I think the first thing I’d do is go straight to a real sushi place in Tokyo and then walk to a nearby shrine because I want to taste the fresh fish and feel the old tradition, but I’m kinda worried I won’t know how to order or find it, so I hope I say it right.

That sounds like a perfect plan! I think you will do great because you are prepared. Don't worry about ordering; locals really appreciate when you try. If you were actually in that restaurant in Tokyo, what is the very first thing you would order to eat?
I would probably order salmon nigiri, because I think it’s the most fresh, but I no know how to ask for it in Japanese and I’m scared I will sound weird.

Salmon nigiri is a great choice! You don't know how to ask for it in Japanese, but don't worry, you'll learn. If you were there right now, how would you try to order it if you couldn't speak the language?

Hey there! I'm Leo. Today we're going to explore some amazing countries and cool cultures around the world. If you could pack your bags and go anywhere right now, which country would you choose to visit?

I think I would love to go to Japan because i want to see the temples, eat sushi, and learn about the crazy cool traditions, but i also worry that my english is not good enough to talk with the people there.    Ugh, this is so hard to say!

Japan sounds like an incredible choice for all those reasons! And don't worry, you think your English isn't good enough, but you are doing great. Besides sushi and temples, what is one thing you think you would enjoy most about their culture?
(sin respuesta)

Japan has so many unique things to see, maybe you would like to visit the busy streets of Tokyo or see the beautiful mountains. What do you think you would enjoy more, the modern cities or the peaceful nature?

I think I would probably like the modern cities more because the big lights, the trains and all the technology makes me feel excited, but I also feel a little scared that I might get lost in Tokyo’s streets and I don’t know if I could find the quiet parks; ugh, it’s hard to choose because both sound

It sounds like the big lights and the technology make you feel excited! I think that choosing between nature and the city is tough because both options are amazing. If you were in Tokyo, would you rather explore the city alone or with a friend?

Hey there! I'm Leo. Today we are going to talk about travel, cultures, and some cool places you would love to visit someday. If you could pack your bags right now and go anywhere in the world, where would you go?
I would love to go to Japan because I love sushi and anime, but I don’t know if I can speak the language or not and it makes me a little scared, still it would be super awesome!

That sounds like an incredible adventure! You said you do not know if you can speak the language, but you will find that many people are very helpful. Since you are a fan of anime and sushi, what is the first thing you would do when you arrive in Tokyo?
(sin respuesta)
Imagine you just landed! Would you go straight to a busy sushi restaurant, or would you look for an anime store first?

I would probably run straight to an anime store first, because I want to see all the new figures and maybe get some manga, but at the same time I’m also super hungry so I don’t know if I should try a sushi restaurant right after, ugh I wish I could decide!

That is a tough choice! Getting some new manga sounds like a great way to start, but I think you should try the sushi right after since you are hungry. If you had to pick just one activity for your first day, which one would you choose?
